Metadata.title: Beeri Packaging — Custom Branded Carton Packaging
Metadata.description: Branded carton packaging for the pharma, food, cosmetics and wine industries — structural design, offset & digital print, die-cutting, gluing, finishing and end-to-end professional guidance.

Presentation.title: The new Beeri Packaging website
Presentation.description: A guided tour of the new Beeri Packaging website.

home.title: A clear first impression
home.body: The opening immediately explains the company’s field and promise: packaging that works for the product.

home.title: A journey that explains the process
home.body: The page moves from the customer need through planning and production without presenting everything at once.

home.title: A clear path to action
home.body: Frequently asked questions and a focused contact invitation complete the journey.

about.title: The Beeri story
about.body: The page connects a long industrial heritage with the company’s capabilities today.

about.title: Trust built through facts
about.body: The timeline and key figures communicate experience, scale and delivery capacity visually.

about.title: People, production and culture
about.body: The content gives the company a human face and reinforces the sense of partnership.

catalog.title: A faster route to solutions
catalog.body: The catalog organizes the offer by need and packaging type, shortening the route to a relevant product.

catalog.title: The product stays central
catalog.body: Large imagery and focused information clarify structure, material and intended use.

catalog.title: A natural route to an inquiry
catalog.body: Every product can lead directly to a professional conversation and a tailored solution.

finishing.title: Turning packaging into a brand asset
finishing.body: The page shows how finishing techniques create distinction and shelf presence.

finishing.title: Visual and focused explanations
finishing.body: Every technique is presented through an example, its result and the value it adds to the product.

finishing.title: Creativity connected to production
finishing.body: The conclusion reinforces that these options are available within a complete production process.

journal.title: A professional knowledge center
journal.body: The journal turns Beeri’s experience into useful content for customers and decision-makers.

journal.title: Proof from real work
journal.body: Projects, awards and practical guides strengthen expertise and credibility.

journal.title: A channel that keeps growing
journal.body: Fresh content supports organic visibility and gives visitors a reason to return.
